explanation: The statement is a double-counting identity: |C(t)|·|{v ~ t commuting with z}| = |C(z)|·|{u ~ z commuting with t}|. Its proof uses two library-local lemmas (card_centralizer_mul_card_conjugatesOf and card_conj_mul_card_comm) plus cancellation. I searched Mathlib for lemmas relating centralizer cardinality to conjugacy-class cardinality, and for commuting-pair counts, using grep patterns on card/centralizer/conjugatesOf/IsConj/comm. The only hits were `card_comm_eq_card_conjClasses_mul_card` (Mathlib/GroupTheory/GroupAction/CardCommute.lean), which counts all commuting pairs, and the orbit-stabilizer theorems. Neither states this symmetric identity, and neither gets it in one or two lines.
